<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AccidentInformation" name="Accident information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PrivateInsuranceReport" name="Written accident report to private insurer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SelfEmployedReport" name="Accident report by self-employed person"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DirectorateReport" name="Accident report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_InspectorateReport" name="Fatality or serious injury report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_InsurerReport" name="Accident report to accident insurance provider"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Education" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_Education"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Inspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately" messageRef="Msg_AccidentInformation" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="Start_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PrivateInsurer" name="Written report to private insurer" messageRef="Msg_PrivateInsuranceReport" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_Insurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SelfEmployedInsurer" name="Report by self-employed person" messageRef="Msg_SelfEmployedReport" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfInsurer" targetRef="Participant_Insurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InsuredDirectorate" name="Report to directorate" messageRef="Msg_DirectorateReport" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmployerInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate" messageRef="Msg_InspectorateReport" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmployerInsurer" name="Report to insurer within five days" messageRef="Msg_InsurerReport" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_Insurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EducationInsurer" name="Triplicate report to insurer within five days" messageRef="Msg_InsurerReport" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurerTriplicate" targetRef="Participant_Insurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Insured person -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insured" name="Insured person process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AccidentOccurs" name="Accident or near miss occurs">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineEventType" name="Determine type of event">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EventType_Split" name="Type of event">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Notify_Join" name="Notification needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingPath_Split" name="Further reporting obligation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident in writing immediately to private insurer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSelfInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider in good time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateReported" name="Private insurer notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfReported" name="Insurance provider notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DirectorateReported" name="Directorate notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerResponsible" name="Employer responsible for further reporting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I1" sourceRef="Start_AccidentOccurs" targetRef="Task_DetermineEventType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I2" sourceRef="Task_DetermineEventType" targetRef="Gateway_EventType_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I3" name="Work accident" sourceRef="Gateway_EventType_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I4" name="Near miss" sourceRef="Gateway_EventType_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I5" name="Serious risk or defect in protection systems" sourceRef="Gateway_EventType_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I6" sourceRef="Gateway_Notify_Join" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I7" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingPath_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I8" name="Private insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingPath_Split" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I9" name="Self-employed person" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingPath_Split" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I10" name="Student or schoolchild" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingPath_Split" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I11" name="Employee under statutory accident insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingPath_Split" targetRef="End_EmployerResponsible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I12" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="End_PrivateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I13" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfInsurer" targetRef="End_SelfReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I14" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="End_DirectorateReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Employer -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeReport" name="Accident information received from employee">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_EmployeeReport" messageRef="Msg_AccidentInformation"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordAccident" name="Record accident information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Severity_Split" name="Fatality or serious injury?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Severity_Join" name="Severity assessed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Incapacity_Split" name="Killed or unable to work for three days?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider within five days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Incapacity_Join" name="Reporting obligation handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerDone" name="Accident information processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeReport" targetRef="Task_RecordAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E2" sourceRef="Task_RecordAccident" targetRef="Gateway_Severity_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E3" name="Fatality or serious injury not reported to emergency services" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity_Split" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E4" name="No fatality or serious injury" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Severity_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E5" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_Severity_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E6" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Incapacity_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E7" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Incapacity_Split" targetRef="Task_ReportInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E8" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Incapacity_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Incapacity_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E9" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_Incapacity_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E10" sourceRef="Gateway_Incapacity_Join" targetRef="End_EmployerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- School, educational facility or university -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Education" name="Educational institution process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Accident of pupil or student occurs">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_X1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInsurerTriplicate" name="Report accident in triplicate to accident insurance provider within five days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_X1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_X2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EducationReported" name="Accident reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_X2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_X1" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportInsurerTriplicate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_X2" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurerTriplicate" targetRef="End_EducationReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description makes a notification of an occurrence to one party conditional on whether the same occurrence has already been communicated to another party, and separately states that a notification of that occurrence must still be sent to a different party regardless of that earlier communication: Model an exclusive gateway before the conditional notification task, with one labeled outgoing sequence flow for the case where the earlier communication was made and one for the case where it was not. Route only the case the description makes conditional into the notification task. Model any notification the description requires regardless of the earlier communication as its own task on a path that is not controlled by that gateway, so it is never skipped. Do not nest the unconditional notification inside the branch of the conditional one.
rules.situation: the description makes a notification of an occurrence to one party conditional on whether the same occurrence has already been communicated to another party, and separately states that a notification of that occurrence must still be sent to a different party regardless of that earlier communication

rules.instruction: When the description states that a party must notify an external body about an event only when two conditions hold in sequence, such as a severity condition on the event and a check that no other party has already made the same notification, and the notification must not happen otherwise: Model each condition as its own exclusive gateway, placed in the order the description states them. Place the notification as its own task only on the path where every condition holds, and keep it separate from other steps rather than merging it into a gateway or another task. Route the paths where any condition fails past the notification. Merge all paths with an exclusive gateway before the process continues.
rules.situation: the description states that a party must notify an external body about an event only when two conditions hold in sequence, such as a severity condition on the event and a check that no other party has already made the same notification, and the notification must not happen otherwise

rules.instruction: When the description states a condition that decides whether the process continues to a further outcome or ends, for example 'if all criteria are met, ...' followed by a consequence: Model an exclusive gateway at the point where the condition is decided, with one labeled outgoing sequence flow for each outcome the description states. Place the gateway before the outcome that the condition governs, and do not leave the conditional outcome as an unconditional sequence of tasks.
rules.situation: the description makes a report to a named body apply only when a stated condition holds, and that condition is whether another party has already made the same report or whether the affected person holds a cover that the report depends on

rules.instruction: When the description states a check of one condition, and a second check on a different condition applies only to cases where the first check holds, with a required report or action following from the second check: Model one exclusive gateway per check, in the order the description states them. Route the branch where the first check holds by a sequence flow into the second gateway, so the second check is reached only after the first has passed. Place the required report or action as a task on the branch of the second gateway where its check holds. Do not connect the second gateway from any branch that bypasses the first check.
rules.situation: the description states a check of one condition, and a second check on a different condition applies only to cases where the first check holds, with a required report or action following from the second check

rules.instruction: When the description attaches a timing qualifier such as 'immediately', 'within N days' or 'in good time' to an action or to a notification sent to another party: Name the task by its action verb, its object and its addressee only, as the description states them, and leave the timing qualifier out of the task label. Record the timing as a text annotation associated with that task, so that the deadline remains visible without changing the label.
